mcp.name: run_statistical_analysis
mcp.description: Run a bounded local statistical method with an explicit descriptive, exploratory, or confirmatory purpose. Inline requests carry request.data. Source-bound Kaplan-Meier, Welch one-way ANOVA, Friedman, ROC, two-factor quadratic response-surface, and Gaussian random-intercept LMM requests omit request.data and deterministically project one exact immutable Data Table through a method-discriminated source_table. Raw data and source_table are mutually exclusive. Confirmatory runs require an exact frozen AnalysisSpec version/hash, exact input artifact versions/hashes, a model hash, and an agentlas.statistics.method:<method> token frozen in requiredDiagnostics; the projection and binding are preserved in run input, provenance, artifact, and receipt. Any other registered method projects with projection_kind = declared-columns, mapping table columns onto the data shape the method declares; the receipt is recorded as for the bespoke projections.

oneOf.description: Project the exact table into the shape the method itself declares. Use when the method has no bespoke projection above: `columns` maps each declared data property to table columns, so a method becomes reachable from an uploaded table the day it is registered rather than when someone writes it a projection by hand.

columns.description: One entry per declared data property. `{"column": "c"}` for a flat array; `{"columns": ["a","b"]}` for one named series per column; `{"nameColumn": "g", "valueColumn": "v"}` for a long layout; `{"rowColumns": {"field": "col"}}` for one entry per row; `{"value": 12}` for a declared parameter.

preparation.description: Optional narrowing applied to the exact table BEFORE projection, recorded in the projection receipt. Keeps some rows and/or adds one derived label column. It cannot invent a measurement: every value is a cell that was already there or a label computed from one by this rule.

filter.description: Keep only the rows where one column satisfies one comparison, e.g. magnitude >= the completeness cut. Text columns support == and != only.

derive.description: Add one text column by cutting a numeric column at a threshold into two named groups, e.g. days_since_mainshock < 1 becomes early / late. This is how a series is split into the windows a comparison needs when the grouping is a decision about the data rather than a column in it.

mcp.name: render_table_as_vega
mcp.description: Create a durable Agentlas Science Vega artifact from measured tabular rows. The exact run, artifact version, and Data Visualization Lab ownership are recorded in the current research turn.

mcp.name: build_literature_citation_network
mcp.description: Build a durable interactive citation network from one exact successful academic-search run. OpenAlex citation and related-work links remain separately typed, isolated records are preserved, and no edges are invented.

mcp.name: build_astronomy_sky_map
mcp.description: Build a durable interactive sky-catalog artifact from one exact successful SIMBAD TAP cone-search run. The raw provider response, normalized catalog, coordinates, measured fields, and local D3 view remain hash-linked; missing measurements are never imputed.

mcp.name: analyze_light_curve_periodicity
mcp.description: Project one exact immutable Data Table into a bounded irregular astronomical light curve and run a deterministic weighted floating-mean generalized Lomb-Scargle analysis. Every nullable observation is preserved, no measurement is imputed, the source artifact version/hash and column mapping remain bound to the run, and the result materializes publication tables plus a durable Vega-Lite Figure. It reports a Baluev (2008) analytic false-alarm upper bound and a Montgomery-O'Donoghue (1999) period standard-error estimate when numerically resolvable; these are model estimates rather than calibrated detection probabilities or confidence intervals, and a returned 0 is a numerical floor rather than exact certainty.

mcp.name: analyze_light_curve_periodicity_depth
mcp.description: Project one exact immutable Data Table into a bounded irregular astronomical light curve and run the depth analysis: Baluev analytic upper-bound FAP, optional seeded permutation-bootstrap FAP, peak-width/analytic/bootstrap period uncertainty, daily and sidereal alias screening, and a fixed two-harmonic refinement. Source artifact version/hash and column mapping remain bound to the run, publication tables and a durable Vega-Lite Figure are materialized, and a zero bootstrap exceedance is reported with its finite-sample upper bound rather than as exact FAP=0. White-noise, sampling, time-system, and model limitations remain explicit in the result boundaries.

bootstrap_samples.description: Number of seeded permutation and residual-bootstrap replicates; zero skips bootstrap estimates.

bootstrap_seed.description: Deterministic seed for the permutation and residual bootstrap.

alias_periods_days.description: Declared daily/sidereal or other alias periods to screen against the sampling window.

false_alarm_levels.description: Baluev upper-bound levels for periodogram threshold construction.

mcp.name: build_biodiversity_occurrence_map
mcp.description: Build a durable interactive Vega occurrence map from one exact successful GBIF catalog run. Raw provider JSON, immutable Source bytes, normalized coordinates, provider issue flags, and the local map remain hash-linked; no missing values are imputed.

mcp.name: analyze_paleontology_stratigraphic_support
mcp.description: Analyze one exact successful PBDB catalog run as preserved fossil-occurrence and stratigraphic support. The trusted host materializes a row-auditable table and an interactive interval Figure while retaining named formations, age bounds, missingness, source hashes, and the distinction between occurrence evidence and morphology, molecular, genome, embryo, hatching, or de-extinction claims.

mcp.name: compare_fossil_candidate_evidence
mcp.description: Compare two or more exact successful PBDB catalog and stratigraphic-analysis run pairs as a normalized descriptive matrix and publication table. The trusted host rehydrates and verifies every immutable parent; no caller-supplied evidence, ranking, molecular evidence, genome, embryo, hatching, biological-feasibility, or revival score is accepted or produced.

mcp.name: assess_deextinction_feasibility
mcp.description: Audit two or more exact candidates under either actual biological revival or comparative proxy research. The host seals every source run and output, applies four non-compensable biological evidence gates, emits no biological feasibility score, and fixes PBDB fossil coverage contribution to zero. A current installed tool cannot verify a dinosaur DNA, target genome, viable-cell, embryo, hatching, or resurrection claim.

mcp.name: build_earthquake_observation_map
mcp.description: Build a durable interactive Vega earthquake map from one exact successful USGS FDSN catalog run. Raw GeoJSON, immutable Source bytes, normalized event fields, missing values, and the local map remain hash-linked.

mcp.name: analyze_earthquake_gutenberg_richter
mcp.description: Analyze one exact completed USGS catalog run with a researcher-supplied completeness magnitude, bin width, and single magnitude type. The trusted host persists the Aki MLE result, inclusion audit, source hashes, and a durable interactive magnitude-frequency Figure in the Earthquake Observations Lab; completeness estimation, magnitude conversion, declustering, and forecasting remain unsupported.

mcp.name: analyze_aftershock_catalog_table
mcp.description: Analyze one exact project Data Table containing event ids, elapsed days since a mainshock, and magnitudes. The trusted host fits a bounded Omori-Utsu decay model and compares Aki b-values before and after one explicit split, preserving the 400-row parent hash, inclusion counts, numeric results, uncertainty, limitations, publication table, Figure, and ResearchRun receipts. Omori parameter intervals, background seismicity, secondary triggering, and uncertainty in the supplied completeness/split boundaries are not computed.

mcp.name: materialize_physics_measurement_dataset
mcp.description: Normalize a bounded Physics measurement table with exact number/string types and optional units through the installed Agentlas Physics runtime, then persist its hash-bound rows in the Physics Data Lab without truncation or imputation.

mcp.name: analyze_hepdata_chi_square
mcp.description: Compare an explicit prediction vector with one exact completed HEPData table run. The trusted host reconstructs and hash-checks the normalized provider table, applies only researcher-selected uncertainty labels as independent diagonal components, persists directional asymmetric pulls, chi-square, degrees of freedom, p-value, inclusion audit, and a durable measurement Figure. Covariance, correlation, and parameter fitting are never inferred.

mcp.name: fit_physics_spectrum_peaks
mcp.description: Fit one or more spectral peaks (Gaussian, Lorentzian, pseudo-Voigt, Voigt, Crystal Ball, relativistic Breit-Wigner) on a none/polynomial/exponential background to a completed Physics dataset run by Levenberg-Marquardt chi-square minimisation with the caller-declared uncertainty model. The trusted host injects the exact parent table and persists parameters with absolute-sigma and chi-square-scaled errors, covariance/correlation, chi-square/ndf and p-value, per-point residuals and pulls, derived FWHM/area, and a durable data+model+pull Figure. Starting values are the caller's responsibility; LM converges to a local minimum.

dataset_run_id.description: Completed materialize_physics_measurement_dataset run whose exact table is the analysis input.

x_column.description: Numeric column of the parent dataset used as the abscissa (energy, wavelength, channel).

y_column.description: Numeric column with the measured counts or intensity.

sigma_column.description: Numeric column with the per-point standard uncertainty; only valid with uncertainty_model "column".

uncertainty_model.description: column: sigma_column; poisson: sqrt(max(y, 1)); unit: equal weights. Defaults to column when sigma_column is given, else poisson.

initial.description: Starting values keyed by the shape's parameter names: gaussian {amplitude, center, sigma}; lorentzian {amplitude, center, gamma}; pseudo_voigt {amplitude, center, fwhm, eta}; voigt {area, center, sigma, gamma}; crystal_ball {amplitude, center, sigma, alpha, n>1}; relativistic_breit_wigner {area, mass, width}.
polynomial: c0..c_degree; exponential: [a, b] for a·exp(b·x).

mcp.name: compute_physics_significance_limits
mcp.description: Single-bin counting-experiment statistics for observed n, expected background b with Gaussian uncertainty, and expected signal s: profile-likelihood discovery significance Z0 (Cowan et al. 2011), exact Poisson p-value, background-marginalised p-value, asymptotic CLs upper limit on the signal strength with the expected +-1/+-2 sigma bands, and an explicit Feldman-Cousins interval (background treated as known). Persists a publication table, the CLs curve and acceptance belt Figure. Asymptotic formulae are approximate for small counts; no shape, multi-bin or correlated-systematic modelling.

background.description: Expected background b (same units as n).

background_uncertainty.description: Gaussian standard uncertainty on b (0 = background exactly known).

signal_expected.description: Expected signal events s at signal strength mu = 1.

signal_max.description: Upper edge of the signal-events grid (default n + 5 sqrt(n + b) + 10, at least 10).

signal_step.description: Grid step (default max(0.01, signal_max / 2000)); signal_max / signal_step must not exceed 20000.

mcp.name: propagate_physics_uncertainty
mcp.description: Propagate input uncertainties through a closed-form expression (safe parser, no code execution) or a catalogue formula: first-order linear propagation with exact dual-number derivatives and the full covariance (sigmas plus optional correlation matrix), a seeded Monte Carlo with quantiles and skewness, a per-variable uncertainty budget, a linear-vs-Monte-Carlo comparison table, and a histogram/budget Figure. Units are informational and not checked here (use analyze_physics_units).

expression.description: Closed-form model y = f(variables) using + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh exp log ln log10 log2 sqrt cbrt abs pow hypot min max. Provide exactly one of expression or formula.

formula.description: Catalogue formula id; its variables must be declared in variables.

distribution.description: uniform uses half-width sigma·√3 so sigma stays the standard deviation.

correlation.description: Square correlation matrix in variables order; symmetric, unit diagonal, positive definite.

mcp.name: analyze_physics_units
mcp.description: Dimensional analysis on SI base-exponent vectors: convert a value between compound units (curated table with SI prefixes, eV, c, atm, ...), list CODATA 2018 constants with uncertainties and the reference, express a mechanical/thermal quantity in natural units (hbar = c = k_B = 1) as a power of eV, or check that both sides of an equation have the same dimension. Persists the conversion/constant table and an auxiliary exponent Figure.

to.description: convert: target unit with the same dimension.

ids.description: constants: subset of CODATA 2018 ids; default all.

unit.description: natural_units: unit of the quantity (m, kg, s, K dimensions only).

equation.description: check_formula: "lhs = rhs" using the safe expression grammar.

mcp.name: simulate_physics_ode
mcp.description: Simulate one catalogue system (projectile with drag, damped driven oscillator, nonlinear pendulum, series RLC, Lorenz, two-body orbit, radioactive decay chain, logistic, SIR) with an adaptive Dormand-Prince RK5(4) integrator and declared units. Persists a downsampled time-series table, conserved-quantity drift diagnostics, analytic cross-checks where they exist (Bateman, elliptic-integral period, steady-state amplitude, closed-form logistic/projectile), and time-series + phase-space Figure. Explicit non-stiff solver; drift is a diagnostic, not a proof of accuracy.

inputSchema.description: ODE simulation catalogue on an adaptive Dormand–Prince RK5(4) integrator. Parameters and initial_state are validated per system; unknown keys are rejected. Units are declared by the catalogue (see the per-system definitions).

parameters.description: System parameters; every key optional with catalogue defaults. See the per-system if/then blocks.

initial_state.description: Named initial state components; every key optional with catalogue defaults.

preset.description: earth_satellite sets mu = 3.986004418e14 m^3/s^2 and a 400 km circular default state; cannot be combined with mu

mu.description: m^3/s^2 (normalized units when preset is none)

decay_constants.description: 1/s; only the last entry may be 0 (stable). Default [ln2/10, ln2/100, 0]

half_lives.description: s; null = stable; alternative to decay_constants

mcp.name: analyze_physics_signal
mcp.description: Spectral analysis of a uniformly sampled column of a completed Physics dataset run: windowed FFT (radix-2 or Bluestein) amplitude spectrum and power spectral density, dominant peaks refined by quadratic interpolation, FFT autocorrelation with a period estimate, an SNR estimate with stated assumptions, and an optional STFT spectrogram table. Persists the peak table, spectrum/autocorrelation/spectrogram tables and a time-series + spectrum Figure. Uniform sampling only; no spectral uncertainties.

inputSchema.description: Uniformly sampled signal analysis: windowed FFT amplitude spectrum and PSD, dominant peaks with quadratic interpolation, FFT autocorrelation, SNR estimate, optional STFT spectrogram. The table is supplied by the host from a completed physics dataset run; give exactly one of time_column or sample_rate.

dataset_run_id.description: Completed materialize_physics_measurement_dataset run whose exact table is the analysis input.

value_column.description: numeric column holding the samples (no missing cells; at least 8 samples)

time_column.description: numeric time column; spacing must be uniform to 1e-6 relative; the sample rate and its unit are inferred (unit s → Hz, otherwise 1/<unit>)

sample_rate.description: samples per second when no time column exists (assumed Hz)

stft.description: when present, an STFT spectrogram table and panel are produced

frame_size.description: power of two, at most the sample count

autocorrelation_max_lag.description: default min(n − 1, 2000); must be below the sample count

mcp.name: fit_physics_york_line
mcp.description: Straight-line fit with uncertainties in both x and y (York, Evans & Evans 2004; optional per-point x-y error correlation) to a completed Physics dataset run, compared with ordinary and weighted least squares. Persists slope/intercept with covariance, chi-square/ndf and p-value, adjusted points, effective sigmas and pulls, a +-1 sigma band, and a Figure with two-dimensional error bars and a pull panel. Straight-line Gaussian-error model only.

dataset_run_id.description: Completed materialize_physics_measurement_dataset run whose exact table is the analysis input.

x_column.description: Name of the numeric x column

y_column.description: Name of the numeric y column

sigma_x_column.description: Column of positive x standard uncertainties

sigma_y_column.description: Column of positive y standard uncertainties

correlation_column.description: Optional column of per-point x–y error correlations r_i in [-1, 1]; mutually exclusive with correlation

correlation.description: Single x–y error correlation applied to every point; mutually exclusive with correlation_column

range.description: Inclusive x range of points to fit (max > min)

tolerance.description: Relative slope change that stops the York iteration

mcp.name: check_physics_lab_experiment
mcp.description: Teaching-lab checker for free fall (g from distance-time), simple pendulum (g from period-length with the exact finite-amplitude correction), and Ohm's law (R from voltage-current with an offset and a quadratic-term linearity test) on a completed Physics dataset run: weighted linear least squares, uncertainty with declared sigmas or scatter, z-score against standard or WGS84 local gravity or a reference resistance, chi-square/ndf, residual diagnostics (runs test, Durbin-Watson, lag-1 autocorrelation), factual verdict lines, and a data+fit+residual Figure. No systematic-error model.

dataset_run_id.description: Completed materialize_physics_measurement_dataset run whose exact table is the analysis input.

distance_column.description: free_fall: distance fallen from release (m); exactly one of distance_column/height_column

height_column.description: free_fall: alias of distance_column (drop height measured from release, m)

sigma_column.description: free_fall: positive distance uncertainties; when absent errors are scaled from scatter

amplitude_deg.description: pendulum: single release amplitude in degrees for the finite-amplitude correction; mutually exclusive with amplitude_column

amplitude_column.description: pendulum: per-point amplitude column in degrees [0, 180)

sigma_current_column.description: ohms_law: positive current uncertainties, folded into an effective voltage uncertainty with the fitted R

model.description: free_fall: half_g_t_squared | with_initial_velocity (default) | full; pendulum: through_origin (default) | with_intercept; ohms_law: through_origin | with_intercept (default)

reference_g.description: free_fall/pendulum: reference g (m/s²); mutually exclusive with latitude_deg/altitude_m

latitude_deg.description: free_fall/pendulum: latitude for the WGS84 local-g reference

altitude_m.description: free_fall/pendulum: altitude for the WGS84 local-g reference (requires latitude_deg)

reference_resistance.description: ohms_law: reference resistance (Ω) for the z-score

mcp.name: analyze_materials_lattice_metrics
mcp.description: Compute a crystal cell volume from the exact three-dimensional lattice vectors of one structure in a completed OQMD OPTIMADE catalog run. The trusted host persists the determinant method, validation receipt, publication table, source hashes, and a durable Figure; density remains explicitly not computed when composition, Z, or formula weight is absent.

mcp.name: render_source_as_molecular_structure
mcp.description: Create a durable source-bound Mol* artifact from an exact PDB or mmCIF source version in the current project. The result opens in Molecular Structure Lab for interactive inspection.

mcp.name: render_smiles_as_chemistry_document
mcp.description: Convert a SMILES structure with the signed Indigo executor into a durable validated Ketcher document owned by Chemistry Lab.

mcp.name: render_source_as_chemistry_document
mcp.description: Create a durable Ketcher document from the exact PubChem SDF SourceVersion produced by a successful scientific-data retrieval run. The retrieval receipts, immutable source bytes, signed Indigo conversion, artifact provenance, and Chemistry Lab ownership remain linked.

mcp.name: save_vega_artifact_version
mcp.description: Change the title, mark, and approved color of an existing Vega artifact and save a new immutable Lab version. Requires the exact current version and content hash.

mcp.name: save_molecular_structure_view_version
mcp.description: Save a new immutable Mol* artifact version after validating the exact source bytes, representation, color theme, and optional residue selection. Requires the exact current version and content hash.

mcp.name: save_chemistry_smiles_version
mcp.description: Convert an AI-proposed SMILES with the exact signed Indigo executor, reject invalid chemistry, and save a new immutable Ketcher artifact version. Requires the exact current version and content hash.
